about: What each NPC host event does in the world (S6; C08: it was a table in the code; schema 2, VILLAGE_PLAN V02). The core's agents raise the events; an event not listed changes nothing. action is give_item (an item by its stable name, and a count: a number, or qty for the number the learner said, capped at 5), point_at_noun (the beacon goes to the nearest block of a catalogue noun), point_at_place (to a named place of the scene) point_at_slot (to the place a slot of the learner's line names, through the scene's labels: villager.point answers "¿dónde está el río?" and any other place; a place the scene does not have is answered by <npc>.unknown_place), take_item, sell (a purchase: the learner pays the price for each item asked for, no cap; another item is answered by <npc>.wont_sell, none asked for by <npc>.none_asked, too few coins by <npc>.cant_pay, a full bag by <npc>.no_room) or buy (VILLAGE_PLAN V15, the sale turned round: the NPC pays the price for each item the learner sells; none in the bag is answered by <npc>.cant_sell, another item by <npc>.wont_buy, none offered by <npc>.none_offered, a full bag by <npc>.no_room). W08, the teacher at a station: procedure_repeat, procedure_slower and procedure_help do what the Repetir, Más despacio and Ayuda buttons do; give_missing gives the ingredients the run lacks (always for the first bake, then once per in-game day; the agent answers <npc>.nothing_missing, <npc>.gift_used or <npc>.no_room when nothing is given); teach_recipe adds a procedure to the learner's known list and start_procedure opens the station for one (both: the procedure the NPC teaches when none is named, and nothing when it teaches none).
